description: This file defines the AddressFormat class which manages CRUD operations for address format records in a MySQL database within the Opencart e-commerce system. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve individual and multiple address formats, as well as get total count of formats.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: A model class for handling CRUD operations related to address format records in the database.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Creates a new address format record in the database with the provided data.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes the address format record identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific address format record by its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Fetches a list of address format records, optionally filtered by start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total count of address format records in the database.
